description:
Welcome to the official Scale & Bone channel!

Follow the visceral life-cycle of reptiles from leathery egg to apex survivor across 300 million years of evolution.
Clear, visual, research-backed 2D hand-drawn explainers crafted for Nature documentary lovers, evolutionary biology fans, and viewers captivated by survival life-cycles.

Core topics: Reptile & amphibian evolution, egg-to-apex life-cycle survival stories & ancient biomechanics.

#reptiles #evolution #herpetology #lifecycle #naturedocumentary #biology
keywords: Reptile & amphibian evolution, egg-to-apex life-cycle survival stories & ancient biomechanics
